description: This file contains assembly code for cryptographic functions related to the BoringSSL library, specifically for the VP AES encryption/decryption core, key schedule, and related routines, along with associated constants and macros.

methods.name: vpaes_set_encrypt_key
methods.description: Sets the encryption key for VP AES.

methods.name: vpaes_set_decrypt_key
methods.description: Sets the decryption key for VP AES.

methods.name: vpaes_encrypt
methods.description: Performs VP AES encryption on input data.

methods.name: vpaes_decrypt
methods.description: Performs VP AES decryption on input data.

methods.name: vpaes_cbc_encrypt
methods.description: Performs VP AES CBC mode encryption/decryption.

methods.name: vpaes_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Performs VP AES CTR mode encryption on multiple blocks.
